genre_map.title: The circuit and physical design of the POWER4 microprocessor
genre_map.venue: IBM Journal of Research and Development
genre_map.what_design_decisions_it_covers: POWER4 physical design methodology, circuit design, timing closure, dual-core implementation on 130nm, latch-based design, low-power techniques

genre_map.title: POWER4 system microarchitecture
genre_map.venue: IBM Journal of Research and Development
genre_map.what_design_decisions_it_covers: POWER4 microarchitecture, instruction pipeline, dual-core organization, cache hierarchy, branch prediction — companion to the physical design paper in the same special issue

genre_map.title: A 1.0-V 90-nm 80-pF dynamic-random-access memory with a 3.0-GHz data rate and 2.5-V analog front-end
genre_map.what_design_decisions_it_covers: DRAM design decisions — this is borderline; more of a circuit paper than an implementation retrospective

genre_map.title: Design of the DEC Alpha 21364 (EV7) microprocessor
genre_map.what_design_decisions_it_covers: Alpha EV7 microarchitecture and implementation — likely covers some physical design aspects but less focused on P&R methodology

genre_map.title: The Pentium 4 microprocessor
genre_map.authors_if_known: R. E. R bitstring et al.
genre_map.what_design_decisions_it_covers: NetBurst microarchitecture — covers design decisions, some physical design aspects; likely less detail on P&R closure than POWER4 paper
